name: FoodCraft
description: FoodCraft Restaurant is home to coastal favorites and stunning views. Enjoy extraordinary American cuisine with a regional craft beer, a nice glass of wine or one of the best handmade cocktails in Gulf Shores. Top it off with relaxing views Alabama's Gulf Coast or a perfect sunset and you simply can't beat the dining experience.
